name: training-chronicles
description: An ultra-premium digital magazine preserving a training journey.

scripts.dev: npm run packages && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,yellow "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run packages && npm run dev --workspace @chronicles/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run packages && npm run dev --workspace @chronicles/web
scripts.build: npm run packages && npm run build --workspace @chronicles/api && npm run build --workspace @chronicles/web
scripts.build:api: npm run packages && npm run build --workspace @chronicles/api
scripts.build:web: npm run packages && npm run build --workspace @chronicles/web
scripts.seed: npm run packages && npm run seed --workspace @chronicles/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run packages && npm run typecheck --workspace @chronicles/api --workspace @chronicles/web --if-present
